leadText:
Getty (Japanese: チャッキー Chakkie) is a minor recurring character who first appeared in The Clubsplosion Begins!. He is the brother of Angus and Betty.

He and his siblings all entered the Clubsplosion tournament together. He eventually faced off against Betty in Search for the Clubultimate! and lost.

Getty later made a brief appearance in A Clubsplosion of Excitement!, where he and Angus cheered his sister on before her battle with .
